name: Boxer APC (HMG)
description: Drivable Boxer 8x8 APC with a .50 remote weapon station (Explore: E to enter). Driver head-out above the cupola: W/S throttle, A/D steer (front two axles), Space handbrake. Ctrl to the gunner's sight: mouse traverse / elevate, LMB fire, RMB zoom. Rifle fire does nothing; .50, rockets and shells wear it down. Supplied model is local-only; the committed build shows a part-built stand-in.
